code.description: Kebab-case error code identifying the specific validation failure (e.g., missing-field, invalid-ref).

message.description: Human-readable description of the error or warning.

severity.description: Severity level of the diagnostic: info (advisory), warn (non-blocking), error (blocking), or fatal (pipeline halt).

errorState.description: Structured error or diagnostic state emitted by validators and linters during pipeline execution.
